children.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), the provisions of this chapter (other than section 4504 of this title) shall terminate 90 days after the Secretary—
determines that all of the restitutionary amounts to which section 4501(a) of this title applies have been collected and disbursed as provided in this chapter; and
submits to Congress the final report required by section 4505 of this title.
Such final report shall include the determination (and the justification thereof) described in paragraph (1)(A). Such report shall also be published in the Federal Register.

tree.heading: Exception
tree.text: The requirements of section 4502(d) 1 of this title shall continue to be applicable to the use of restitutionary amounts received under this chapter as long as such funds remain available.

notes.text: References in TextSection 4502(d) of this title, referred to in subsec. (b), was repealed by section 4502(e) of this title.
